biggest_gap.candidate_action: FRED/H.15 DGS2: level and delta(K) in bp, sign unresolved, publication and receipt required.
biggest_gap.action: no call: an absent value cannot be filled from a later print, a proxy or a neighbouring session

next_to_obtain: Obtain us_2y_d5_bps: fred DGS2. FRED/H.15 DGS2: level and delta(K) in bp, sign unresolved, publication and receipt required.
Obtain a 05:00 receipt archive: the clock rung passes on 0 mornings, so no morning is valid for either model. A receipt must prove the reading was in hand by 05:00 Europe/London.
Obtain instrument identity: the identified rung passes on 0 mornings, so every saved input is unlabelled as to instrument and source.
Obtain ICE US Dollar Index, cash, official close, USDX: ICE sample and fee letter (docs/research/usd-session/v1/ice_dxy_sample_and_fee_request_20261107.md).
Produce or locate USD-L1-25F-H1-v0.1.0: the four H1 tests stay unscored until its 25 adjudications map to executable rules.

blockers: No file in config, docs/research/usd-session/v1, exports, data or lib/layer1_backtesting names USD-L1-25F-H1-v0.1.0.
The nearest frozen package is usd-l1-factor-rulebook-v1.0.0 with usd-l1-decision-rules-v1.0.0, and its own identity is CONFIG_BLOCKED.
Without the requested package there is no adjudication-to-rule mapping to verify against, so the four H1 tests stay unscored.
package_identity.consequence: The candidate shown and run on this screen is the legacy implemented book, labelled as such. It is not the requested H1 package.

parity.claim: No production parity is claimed for the control: three of the four checked mappings are absent from the saved archive on most mornings, and the fourth uses a broad-index stand-in.

factors.mapping: a single stored spread delta scored against a fixed +/-5 bps band
factors.finding: The input is absent on 714 of 725 mornings, so the rule cannot vote; the German leg is the missing series, not a model judgement.

factors.mapping: selects dxy_d1/dxy_d5/dxy_d20 and scores +/-0.15 per cent on 24h, +/-0.30 per cent elsewhere
factors.finding: The series is FRED DTWEXBGS, a broad trade-weighted index stand-in, not the official ICE cash DXY; the two weight vectors disagree.

factors.mapping: reads the stored event string's surprise field ('positive'/'negative') when its age is at most 72 hours
factors.finding: The event string is taken unexamined and is absent on 714 of 725 mornings; no surprise score is computed or validated.

factors.mapping: a hawkish string scores BULLISH, a dovish string BEARISH, and a neutral string is counted as missing
factors.finding: Neutral is a valid observation but the code removes F8 from the vote instead of voting neutral; the input is absent on 714 of 725 mornings.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.summary: 25 registered factor chains, five assignment files and the frozen session contract.
detail: The programme registers 25 factor chains in data/research-library/catalog.json; ten carry deployed factor ids and fifteen are research-named.
The USD session contract is frozen at 05:00 Europe/London with a 24-hour window and DST following.
The four H1 tests are defined in lib/layer1_backtesting/tests.js and are not scored by this node.

nodes.summary: The frozen 25-row rulebook and the decision rules, both version stamped and hashed.
detail: Rulebook version usd-l1-factor-rulebook-v1.0.0, frozen 2026-11-15.
Every row is disposition Blocked: the adjudication validates no sign, weight or threshold.
USD-L1-25F-H1-v0.1.0 is absent from this checkout; the nearest frozen package is the v1.0.0 book.

nodes.label: 25 adjudications to rules
nodes.summary: 7 of 25 rows have an enforced executable vote; 1 share a vote; 7 are declared but not implemented; 10 hypotheses are visible.
detail: The mapping is incomplete: at least one adjudication has no enforced executable rule.
Families: Rates (3 signals), Risk and volatility (3 signals), USD level and momentum (3 signals), Gold and commodities (1 signals), Cross-asset (1 signals), Events and calendar (1 signals).
Every hypothesis the mapping introduces is listed in the inspector, including the ones the adjudications did not settle.

evidence.note: the independent mapping review and its hypotheses
requirement_table: one row per adjudication with its fields and source

nodes.label: Factor combination
nodes.summary: Six families, twelve voting signals, one vote per morning, capped and deadbanded.
detail: A family votes as the arithmetic mean of its usable signals, capped to [-1, +1]; the net score is the sum of usable family votes.
A direction exists only outside the frozen 0.20 deadband; an exact net zero is NO_CALL.
The trade floor is band 3 with all twelve signals usable and a readable event family; it is provisional.

direction, bands, eligibility and trade rule

nodes.label: Test 1 · official ICE DXY
detail: One question, one denominator, one measure per model. The official series is not in this checkout.
No proxy is substituted under this test; the broker proxy is test 2, with its own label.
Usable sessions: 0 of 725.

evidence.note: tests.dxy_direction

nodes.label: Test 2 · broker DXY.cash (proxy)
detail: Scored on one-hour broker candles, not the official index, and labelled as a proxy everywhere it appears.
The candidate denominator is the legacy reconstructed call set; it is not the 121 gated calls.
Flat windows are excluded from the accuracy denominator and counted separately.

evidence.note: tests.dxy_direction_broker_cfd

nodes.label: Test 3 · four markets
detail: USD-only: one model call, four market outcomes. It is not a pair-combination measure (OD-1).
Each market keeps its own denominator; no cross-market aggregate is published.
Per-morning outcomes are stored for this test, so its rows carry hits, misses and flats.

evidence.note: tests.four_markets

nodes.label: Test 4 · Layer 2 path
detail: The 5R path is the primary reading and the 3R path is a sensitivity check, not a second test.
No 5-minute tape and no level ladder exist for these dates, so nothing is estimated in place of a tape.
The only evidence is a two-day worked demonstration, which is not a measured result.

evidence.note: tests.l2l_full_5r

candidate_trace.label: candidate
candidate_trace.scored_basis: the published broker-proxy test scores the reconstructed calls; 209 of them have a readable outcome, so the scored sample is not the 121 gated calls

definitions.label: USD direction against the official ICE dollar index
definitions.question: On mornings where the model made a directional call, did the official ICE dollar index close the 05:00-to-05:00 window in that direction?
notes: The official series is not in this checkout, so the denominator is empty: this test has never been scored.
A proxy series is not substituted here; the broker proxy is scored as its own test, with its own label.

definitions.label: USD direction against the broker DXY.cash series (proxy)
definitions.question: On the same mornings, did the broker's DXY.cash series close the window in the called direction, using one candle per 05:00 boundary?
notes: This is a proxy for the official index, and it is labelled as a proxy everywhere it appears.
A flat window (a move inside the flat band) is excluded from the accuracy denominator and counted separately.

definitions.label: Cross-market confirmation in four markets
definitions.question: Did the same USD call point the right way in EUR/USD, gold, bitcoin and the NAS100 over the same window?
notes: This is a USD-only test: one model call, four market outcomes. It is not a pair-combination measure.
Each market carries its own denominator; an aggregate across markets is not reported.

definitions.label: Layer 2 path participation (5R primary, 3R sensitivity)
definitions.question: When a Layer 1 call was handed to the Layer 2 selector, did the 5R path reach its target before its stop, and does the 3R path agree?
definitions.outcome_source: one-hour closes with the layer-2 grid
notes: Both variants are blocked: the selector needs a level grid the replay does not yet produce for these markets.
The 3R variant is a sensitivity check on the 5R result, not a second test.

hypotheses.text: Each family carries one unit of weight and each usable signal inside it votes equally; the adjudications validate no weight at all.
Each family votes as the arithmetic mean of its usable signals, capped to [-1, +1]; a family with fewer usable signals still votes for those it has.
A direction exists only outside the frozen 0.20 deadband; inside it, or on an exact net zero, the morning is NO_CALL.
The trade floor is band 3 with all twelve signals usable and a readable event family. It is a study floor, not an edge.
A missing input makes its signal unusable; nothing is carried forward, proxied or filled from a later print.
The US-DE 2Y spread input is absent on an unstated number of 725 mornings, so the F3 spread rule cannot vote on those mornings even though the row is mapped.
Every one of the 25 adjudications is disposition Blocked: no sign, weight or threshold is validated by the adjudication that produced it.
The dollar series behind F5 is a broad trade-weighted index stand-in, not the official ICE cash DXY.
The control treats a neutral Fed bias as a missing input, so a neutral statement removes F8 from the vote instead of voting neutral.
The book carries no timeframe field: all 25 rows are applied to the 05:00 London session, so no row is specifically an H1 rule.

mapping_review.verdict: The mapping is incomplete: at least one adjudication has no enforced executable rule.

decisions.question: Does pair-combination accuracy mean two independent Layer 1 legs, or the existing USD-only cross-market test?
decisions.decision: Keep the agreed USD-only inverse cross-market test. It is one USD call against four market outcomes and it is test 3. Combining two independent Layer 1 calls is a separate future test with its own definition.
decisions.previous_recommendation: Define it as two independent legs and leave it unscored until a non-USD leg has a frozen rulebook; the four-market test already answers a different question.
effect: tests.four_markets keeps its name, its four per-market denominators and its USD-only reading.
pair_combination is registered as a future test and remains unscored; it is not renamed onto test 3.
decisions.does_not_license: It does not license a second leg, a long/short leg mapping or a pair-level accuracy number.

decisions.question: Which gate defines published readiness and accuracy: presence and freshness, or present + fresh + clocked + identified?
decisions.decision: Headline readiness uses the selected model's strict evidence gate. Each performance result uses its own eligible sample and displays its denominator beside it.
decisions.previous_recommendation: Publish both, labelled; the narrow gate keeps today's numbers comparable and the strict gate keeps the research honest.
effect: Headline ready mornings for either model are the strict-gate count, which is 0 of 725 because no 05:00 receipt exists.
The narrow-gate count stays visible as a labelled comparison, never as the headline.
Every test row prints the sample that produced it; the legacy reconstructed sample is never presented as the strict-gate sample.
decisions.does_not_license: It does not license a single blended accuracy figure, and it does not upgrade a proxy test to a headline.

decisions.question: Should the trade flags on blocked mornings be withdrawn, relabelled, or kept?
decisions.decision: A blocked morning creates no valid decision and no trade. Any contradictory legacy trade flag is preserved as an audit finding, not deleted and not traded.
decisions.previous_recommendation: Yes, or relabel them as conditional; the engine already refuses to publish them and the difference is counted under reconciliation.
effect: The engine keeps trade_eligible false on every blocked or abstained morning.
The published flag is retained and counted under engine_stricter and in the run audit as trade_on_blocked_morning.
The screen shows those flags as audit findings with their dates, never as eligible trades.
decisions.does_not_license: It does not license rewriting the published artefact, and it does not turn a withdrawn flag into a trade.

decisions.question: Is the flat band and the scoring tie policy frozen for the USD session?
decisions.decision: The exact proposed flat bands and the tie treatment are returned per instrument below. They are frozen from development dates only, before any holdout outcome is examined.
decisions.previous_recommendation: Freeze both before any candidate is scored, as the handover requires.
effect: Each instrument carries one band, its development sample and its rule; the band is applied unchanged to the 400 unseen mornings.
A move strictly inside the band is flat: excluded from the accuracy denominator and counted separately.
A vote that nets exactly zero, or sits inside the 0.20 deadband, is NO_CALL; there is no coin flip and no direction-priority tie-break.
decisions.does_not_license: It does not license re-fitting a band after seeing a holdout result, and it does not license dropping flat mornings silently.

tie_treatment.flat_inside_band: a move whose absolute value is strictly below the band is flat: excluded from the accuracy denominator and counted separately as flat
tie_treatment.boundary: a move whose absolute value equals the band is directional, not flat; the band is a strict lower bound
tie_treatment.zero_move: a zero move is flat, never a hit or a miss
tie_treatment.vote_tie: a family vote that nets exactly zero is NO_CALL; opposing families cancel and no direction is chosen
tie_treatment.deadband: a vote inside the frozen 0.20 deadband is NO_CALL; there is no coin flip, no direction priority and no tie-break by conviction
tie_treatment.missing_move: a missing or unreadable price is an exclusion, not a flat and not a miss; it never enters the denominator
tie_treatment.applied_to_holdout: the same band is applied unchanged to the 400 unseen mornings; no band is re-fitted after a holdout result

frozen_bands.note: Every band is derived from development dates only. The holdout was not used to choose, widen or narrow any band, and a later change to a band is a new frozen version, not an edit.

decisions.question: Which coverage figure is authoritative for the candidate: the coverage table's reconstructed calls or the engine's gated calls?
decisions.decision: Trace both to their model, gate, dates and source artefact, show their overlap and exclusions, and report scheduled, reconstructed, valid, directional and scored counts separately. Neither figure is authoritative for the other.
decisions.previous_recommendation: State the coverage rule beside every accuracy figure and treat the table as a reconstruction, not as the model's published call count.
effect: The report and the screen print five counts per model with their own definitions and denominators.
The scored denominator of the broker-proxy test is labelled as the legacy reconstructed sample, because it contains calls the gated engine would not make.
No claim is made that one count is a subset of another; the overlap and the exclusions are printed.
decisions.does_not_license: It does not license treating 515 reconstructed calls as 515 valid calls, or treating 121 gate-passing calls as a scored sample of that size.

definitions.scheduled: every morning in the run's session list
definitions.reconstructed: the coverage table's rebuilt call count: a direction the replay reconstructed from stored inputs
definitions.valid: mornings that pass the strict evidence gate: present, fresh, clocked and identified
definitions.directional: mornings the decision engine records with a direction other than NO_CALL
definitions.scored: mornings that entered the published test's accuracy denominator

control.label: control
control.scored_basis: the published broker-proxy test scores the reconstructed control calls with a readable outcome

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.scored_basis: the published broker-proxy test scores the reconstructed calls; 209 of them have a readable outcome, so the scored sample is not the 121 gated calls

coverage_trace.strict_rule: the strict gate requires a 05:00 receipt and a named instrument; neither archive exists, so no morning is valid for either model
coverage_trace.note: Reconstructed calls and gated directional calls are different populations. The overlap and the exclusions are printed instead of asserting that one contains the other.

legend.blocked: a data gap: a required input, an instrument or a receipt was not in hand at 05:00
legend.valid_abstention: the book had the evidence and chose not to call: every blocking check passed and no trade is implied
legend.no_call: the book was eligible but the vote sat inside the deadband or netted exactly zero
legend.allowed: the implemented book produced a direction; it is not a valid call for the intended H1 package
legend.scored: the morning's outcome is stored and entered a denominator
legend.scored_in_legacy_aggregate: scored in the published aggregate on a reconstructed call, not in the gated sample
legend.not_in_legacy_sample: the engine allows the morning but the published reconstructed call set does not contain it
legend.unmapped: no decision record exists for the morning
